verdict.rationale: Direct server connections, such as SSH, are a fair question for a Unix-like terminal app, so the axis applies. The evidence only lists network lookup utilities (nslookup, whois), which are adjacent tools and do not connect you to your own servers. Nothing documents SSH, SFTP or any other direct connection capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN
